title: Descriptive Text
ringkas: Mendeskripsikan orang, tempat, dan benda secara rinci
goals: memakai **simple present** dan kata kerja penghubung ([[is]], [[looks]], [[seems]], [[feels]]) untuk mendeskripsikan
membedakan [[has / have]] (memiliki) dan [[is / are]] (keadaan) dalam deskripsi
menyusun beberapa kata sifat dengan urutan yang benar: [[a beautiful small old house]]
menulis paragraf deskriptif yang jelas dan hidup

lesson.text: Bagaimana kamu menjelaskan sahabatmu kepada orang yang belum pernah bertemu dengannya? Atau indahnya sebuah pantai? Untuk itu kita memakai **descriptive text**. Tujuannya: **menggambarkan** ciri-ciri seseorang, tempat, atau benda sehingga pembaca bisa membayangkannya.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur descriptive text
lesson.text: Descriptive text punya dua bagian utama:
table: Memperkenalkan hal yang dideskripsikan: siapa atau apa itu
Menjelaskan ciri-cirinya: penampilan, sifat, bagian, atau kegunaan
[[She is tall and slim. She has long black hair.]]

lesson.title: 2. Ciri kebahasaan
table: is, are, looks, seems, feels, smells, tastes
Menyebut bagian atau ciri yang dimiliki

items.ex: The market is crowded on Sundays.

lesson.title: 4. Urutan kata sifat
lesson.text: Kalau memakai beberapa kata sifat sebelum kata benda, urutannya biasanya:

lesson.title: 5. is/are dan has/have dalam deskripsi
lesson.text: Gunakan **be** untuk keadaan atau sifat, dan **have/has** untuk bagian atau benda yang dimiliki.
table: [[She has long hair.]] / [[The room has two windows.]]

lesson.title: Jangan campur
lesson.text: Benar: [[She is tall.]] dan [[She has long hair.]] Salah: *She has tall.* dan *She is long hair.*

lines.en: My best friend is Dina. She is fifteen years old, and she lives next to my house. (Identification)
lines.id: Sahabatku adalah Dina. Dia berumur lima belas tahun, dan dia tinggal di sebelah rumahku.

lines.en: Dina is tall and slim. She has long black hair and brown eyes. She always wears a pink hijab to school.
lines.id: Dina tinggi dan langsing. Dia berambut hitam panjang dan bermata cokelat. Dia selalu memakai hijab merah muda ke sekolah. (Description: penampilan)

lines.en: She is friendly and diligent. She helps me when I have difficulties with my homework, so I am lucky to have her as my friend.
lines.id: Dia ramah dan rajin. Dia membantuku saat aku kesulitan dengan PR, jadi aku beruntung memilikinya sebagai teman. (Description: sifat)

lines.en: Lake Toba is the largest volcanic lake in the world. It is located in North Sumatra, Indonesia. (Identification)
lines.id: Danau Toba adalah danau vulkanik terbesar di dunia. Letaknya di Sumatra Utara, Indonesia.

lines.en: The water is clear and cool. In the middle of the lake, there is a big island called Samosir. The air feels fresh, and the view is very beautiful.
lines.id: Airnya jernih dan sejuk. Di tengah danau terdapat pulau besar bernama Samosir. Udaranya terasa segar dan pemandangannya sangat indah. (Description)

lines.en: Many tourists visit this scenic place every year. They enjoy swimming, taking photos, and trying local food.
lines.id: Banyak wisatawan mengunjungi tempat indah ini setiap tahun. Mereka menikmati berenang, berfoto, dan mencicipi makanan lokal.

lines.en: Dina, have you seen Budi? I can't find him.
lines.id: Dina, apakah kamu melihat Budi? Aku tidak bisa menemukannya.

lines.en: He is tall and thin. He has short curly hair, and he wears a blue jacket.
lines.id: Dia tinggi dan kurus. Rambutnya pendek keriting, dan dia memakai jaket biru.

lines.en: Oh, I think I saw him near the library. He looked tired.
lines.id: Oh, kurasa aku melihatnya dekat perpustakaan. Dia tampak lelah.

lesson.title: Tunjukkan, jangan hanya menyebut
lesson.text: Daripada menulis [[She is nice.]], beri detail: [[She always helps her friends and smiles to everyone.]] Detail membuat pembaca lebih mudah membayangkan.

[[is/are]] untuk keadaan; [[has/have]] untuk bagian atau benda yang dimiliki.
Beri detail yang spesifik supaya deskripsi hidup.

Nenekku tinggal di rumah kayu tua di sebuah desa kecil. Rumah itu punya halaman depan luas dengan pohon mangga besar. Sore hari, halamannya sejuk dan tenang.
Di dalam, ruang tamunya sederhana tetapi nyaman. Ada bangku kayu panjang, jam tua yang berdentang setiap jam, dan rak penuh foto. Dapurnya beraroma kelapa segar dan rempah, karena Nenek memasak setiap pagi. Aku selalu merasa seperti di rumah sendiri di sana.

read.text:
My grandmother lives in an old wooden house in a small village. The house has a wide front yard with a big mango tree. In the afternoon, the yard is cool and quiet.
Inside, the living room is simple but cozy. There is a long wooden bench, an old clock that chimes every hour, and a shelf full of photographs. The kitchen smells of fresh coconut and spices, because Grandma cooks every morning. I always feel at home there.
read.title: My Grandmother's House

Rani adalah sepupuku. Dia berumur tujuh belas tahun, tinggi, dan langsing, dengan rambut hitam lurus panjang. Wajahnya bulat dan hidungnya kecil. Ketika dia tersenyum, dua lesung pipi muncul di pipinya.
Rani sangat rajin dan ramah. Dia juga pemberani. Bulan lalu dia memenangi lomba debat tingkat nasional. Semua orang di keluarga kami bangga padanya.

read.text:
Rani is my cousin. She is seventeen years old, tall, and slim, with long straight black hair. She has a round face and a small nose. When she smiles, two dimples appear on her cheeks.
Rani is very diligent and friendly. She is also brave. Last month she won a national debate competition. Everyone in our family is proud of her.

read.id:
Nenekku punya taman yang indah di belakang rumahnya. Tamannya tidak terlalu luas, tetapi selalu berwarna-warni. Ada mawar merah, bunga matahari kuning, dan melati putih. Melati beraroma manis pada sore hari.
Di tengah taman ada kolam kecil. Beberapa ikan mas berenang di dalamnya, dan sebuah patung katak batu duduk di sampingnya. Nenekku menyiram tanaman setiap pagi, dan dia bernyanyi pelan sambil bekerja.

read.text:
My grandmother has a beautiful garden behind her house. It is not very large, but it is always colorful. There are red roses, yellow sunflowers, and white jasmine. The jasmine smells sweet in the evening.
In the middle of the garden, there is a small pond. Some goldfish swim in it, and a stone frog sits next to it. My grandmother waters the plants every morning, and she sings quietly while she works.
read.title: My Grandmother's Garden

Ketika aku kecil, kami tinggal di lingkungan kecil dekat sungai. Rumah-rumahnya tua dan sempit, tetapi nyaman. Ada pohon beringin besar di depan rumah kami, dan anak-anak bermain di bawahnya setiap sore.
Para tetangga kami ramah. Setiap hari Minggu, mereka membawa makanan dan kami makan bersama di halaman. Sungainya bersih saat itu, dan kami bisa berenang di sana. Kini, lingkungannya berbeda, tetapi aku masih mengingatnya dengan jelas.

read.text:
When I was a child, we lived in a small neighborhood near the river. The houses were old and narrow, but they were cozy. There was a big banyan tree in front of our house, and children played under it every afternoon.
Our neighbors were friendly. Every Sunday, they brought food and we ate together in the yard. The river was clean then, and we could swim in it. Now, the neighborhood is different, but I still remember it clearly.
read.title: My Old Neighborhood

read.focus: Would dan used to untuk kebiasaan masa lalu
read.id:
Dina: Kakek, bagaimana keadaan desa Kakek ketika masih muda? Kakek: Tenang dan hijau. Setiap pagi, kami biasa berjalan ke sungai, dan mencuci pakaian di sana. Kami biasa makan buah dari pohon.
Dina: Apakah dulu ada listrik? Kakek: Tidak ada. Pada malam hari, kami biasa duduk mengelilingi lampu, dan ayahku biasa bercerita. Sekarang Kakek merindukan malam-malam itu. Dina: Desa Kakek terdengar damai.

There wasn't any electricity in the village.
We used to eat fruit from the trees.
My father would tell us stories.

Which word can replace "would" in "we would sit around a lamp" for a past habit?
Pasangkan pola dengan fungsinya:
Every morning, we ___ walk to the river.
There ___ any electricity in the village.

qs.answer: We used to eat fruit from the trees.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Kami biasa makan buah dari pohon."

read.text:
Dina: Grandpa, what was your village like when you were young? Grandpa: It was quiet and green. Every morning, we would walk to the river, and we would wash our clothes there. We used to eat fruit from the trees.
Dina: Was there electricity? Grandpa: No, there wasn't. In the evening, we would sit around a lamp, and my father would tell us stories. Now I miss those evenings. Dina: Your village sounds peaceful.
read.title: When My Grandfather Was Young
